title: Spatial Heuristic Strategy based Diffusion Reinforcement Learning for Online 3D Bin Packing
abstract: arXiv:2610.32241v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Traditional heuristic methods have accumulated mature experience in core objectives, such as space utilization and layout compactness of 3D bin packing, relying on artificially designed rule-based logic. However, they exhibit obvious limitations in generalization ability and adaptability to dynamic scenarios. Nevertheless, there remain issues including insufficient perception of the spatial topological structure in 3D bin packing and limited layout optimization capability. translated_title: 基于空间启发式策略的扩散强化学习用于在线三维装箱问题
translated_abstract: 传统的启发式方法依靠人工设计的规则逻辑，在三维装箱的空间利用率和布局紧凑性等核心目标上积累了成熟的经验。然而，它们在泛化能力和对动态场景的适应性方面表现出明显的局限性。扩散强化学习融合了强化学习的空间搜索能力和扩散学习的数据分布建模能力，在动作分布建模和决策合规约束方面取得了一定进展。然而，仍然存在对三维装箱问题中空间拓扑结构感知不足以及布局优化能力有限等问题。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种融合空间启发式策略的扩散强化学习方法，该方法将经典的装箱启发式规则与扩散重构机制相结合……
tldr: 本文提出一种融合空间启发式策略的扩散强化学习方法，将经典装箱启发式规则与扩散强化学习相结合，以增强在线三维装箱中的空间拓扑感知能力和布局优化效果。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a diffusion reinforcement learning method integrated with spatial heuristic strategies, combining classical bin packing heuristic rules with diffusion reinforcement learning to enhance spatial topology perception and layout optimization for online 3D bin packing.
